value.gcp-datasources.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: Google Cloud Monitoring
    type: stackdriver
    uid: gcp-monitoring
    access: proxy
    editable: false
    jsonData:
      authenticationType: jwt
      clientEmail: unknown
      defaultProject: da-cn-devnet
      tokenUri: https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token
    secureJsonData:
      privateKey: unknown
  - name: Google Cloud Logging
    type: googlecloud-logging-datasource
    uid: gcp-logging
    access: proxy
    editable: false
    jsonData:
      authenticationType: jwt
      clientEmail: unknown
      defaultProject: da-cn-devnet
      tokenUri: https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token
    secureJsonData:
      privateKey: unknown
